next_step: Finalize Dedicated pricing + EU-region SLA review; schedule pricing review with finance and legal; run 2-week POC with EU-region pinning
notes: AE notes (Avery): inbound from product team at Hemisphere Loom. Mid-market analytics SaaS; 300 employees, EU HQ (Dublin).
High-level ask: tighten support-chat + doc search latency for EU customers; start on Hosted API to iterate, then move to Dedicated for steady traffic & SLAs.

Security: must prove EU data residency for PII and customer transcripts. Legal flagged no cross-border fallback for 'sensitive' routes. They are open to non-EU fallbacks for anonymized telemetry only.
Quote from Head of Platform: 'we need a clear guarantee that chat logs for EU tenants never leave eu-west-1 — but lower priority tasks can legally route elsewhere.'
POC asks: 2-week POC, 50 qps sustained, p95 latency target <200ms for short-chat paths, sampling for quality checks. Baseline: current infra 280ms p95 and higher cost per token.
Model preference: prefer an open/instruction-tuned model (planning to evaluate Redwood-curated 13B and 70B variants). Will accept quantized variants if quality OK.
Routing: ask for per-tenant region pinning + multi-region routing policy (primary eu-west, fallback eu-central then us-west for non-sensitive). AE requested architecture doc on routing behavior.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; targeting $5-10k/month after Dedicated commit. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching & quantization to hit cost targets.
Notes on Dedicated: cares about predictable throughput, burst capacity for product launches. Wants SLA for regional uptime and latency tiers.
Internal stakeholders: Head of Platform (Eva Müller), CTO (Rafael Gomes), Procurement (Sinead O'Connor). Demo attendees included product, infra & security.
Next ask from AE: handoff to SE (Lena) for POC design, security deep-dive with Security PM, and finance intro for committed pricing.

requirements_summary: Start: Hosted API trial to validate latency & quality in EU region
If passing: migrate to Dedicated reserved capacity with region pinning and SLA
Key requirements: EU data residency for certain tenants, per-tenant routing policies, audit logging, SSO/SAML, KMS integration
Latency: p95 <200ms for short chat requests in EU; throughput 50 qps baseline, burst to 150 qps
Cost target post-migration: $5k-10k/month ARR-equivalent; willing to commit for discounted Dedicated pricing if SLAs met
